name: diary-word-count-tracker
summary: Obsidian plugin that writes a words_written frontmatter field to notes under a target folder (default PRIVATE/Diary) on an idle-gated poll loop.

capabilities.name: Word count to frontmatter
capabilities.description: Counts words with frontmatter and an optional footer stripped and writes words_written when the count changed.

capabilities.name: Idle-gated poll loop
capabilities.description: Polls the active note and writes only after the idle threshold.

capabilities.name: Target folder and footer marker
capabilities.description: Configurable whole-folder scope and a whole-line footer marker excluded from the count (in the Unreleased section of the changelog, after 1.0.0).

capabilities.name: Cursor and scroll restore
capabilities.description: Fixes the iOS jump to the top of the note after each automatic update.

capabilities.name: Unit tests
capabilities.description: Vitest suite on the pure core logic.

limitations.description: getActiveFile() does not disambiguate the active pane in a split view.
No merge logic if two devices write words_written before syncing.
A change can lag by up to one poll interval.
